issues.body: renderIri still wraps any text that is neither recognized as absolute nor matched as a prefixed name in angle brackets, while validateModel only checks empty terms and unknown recognized prefixes. A predicate such as `bad predicate` therefore becomes `<bad predicate>`, which is not a valid SPARQL IRIREF, yet buildQuery can report runnable=true. This directly violates the documented guarantee that invalid generated SPARQL cannot run.
issues.fix_hint: Validate every class, attribute predicate, edge predicate/alternative, and IRI-valued filter as a syntactically valid absolute IRI/IRIREF, supported prefixed name, or `a` where permitted. Treat forbidden IRIREF characters as errors and add a buildQuery test using whitespace in a predicate that asserts runnable=false.
issues.title: Malformed IRI text is still serialized into invalid but runnable SPARQL

issues.body: renderValue still maps every boolean string other than case-insensitive `true` to `false`. The test continues to require `no` to render as `false`, so visible user input can execute with a different value instead of being rejected. That contradicts the no-hidden-rewriting claim.
issues.fix_hint: Accept only the supported SPARQL boolean lexical forms, report any other value as a validation error, and keep best-effort rendering from substituting a different semantic value. Replace the `no` expectation with a buildQuery test asserting runnable=false.
issues.title: Invalid boolean input is still silently changed to false

issues.body: validateModel still does not verify groupBy entries against variables currently bound outside NOT EXISTS. Because groupBy stores bare strings and node/attribute rename or deletion does not update them, a routine edit can leave `SELECT ?human ... GROUP BY ?person` runnable; without aggregates this receives only the generic warning and changes the result shape relative to the canvas.
issues.fix_hint: Validate each GROUP BY entry against the currently in-scope bound variables and make stale, invalid, negated-only, or duplicate entries errors, or update result-shape references atomically on rename/delete. Add a state-transition-style test that groups a variable, renames or removes its owner, and asserts runnable=false until repaired.
issues.title: Stale GROUP BY variables remain runnable after model edits

verdict.summary: Round 4 is stagnant: all three round-3 major correctness findings remain in the submitted diff. Malformed IRI-position text is still serialized into invalid SPARQL without a validation error, invalid boolean text is still silently rewritten to false, and stale GROUP BY entries are still not checked against currently bound non-negated variables. The existing tests preserve the boolean misrewrite and do not exercise either malformed IRI rejection or a group-by rename/delete transition.
